concept: Epic dark style with aura/energy effects, high-end esports matchmaking platform.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing with dense data clusters. Use 'Bento' grid for dashboard panels.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.player_card: Solid surface with neon border glow on hover. bg-[#0E0B16] border border-border hover:border-[#FBBF24] hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.2)] transition-all duration-300
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#05030A]/80 border-b border-white/5

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FBBF24] to-[#F59E0B] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(251,191,36,0.6)] transform hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-200

components.matchmaking_button: Massive central button, glowing pulse animation using framer-motion, radial gradient background. 'MATCHMAKING'

rank_badges.0-49: Guerrero de clase baja - Gray/Slate - border-slate-500 text-slate-400
rank_badges.50-149: Guerrero de clase media - Green/Teal - border-teal-500 text-teal-400
rank_badges.150-249: Guerrero de clase alta - Red/Orange - border-orange-500 text-orange-400

components.scoreboard: Minimalist digital display, large glowing numbers, segmented progress for the 'best of 3' set.
components.avatar_upload: Circular crop with a glowing ring border based on rank.
components.team_emblem: Hexagonal or shield-shaped container for team logos.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Increase border opacity, add/intensify drop-shadow glow, slight negative translate-Y.
motion_and_interactions.match_found: Screen shake effect, sudden bright flash (overlay opacity flash), text reveals 'RIVAL ENCONTRADO'.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight scale up (0.98 to 1) for a snappy, game-like feel.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use an energy aura spinner or a pulsing DBZ-style radar blip.

hero_background.description: Dark cosmic nebula background, used with heavy black gradient overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text readability.
hero_background.usage: Login/Register page background, main dashboard subtle background pattern.

energy_effect.usage: Use as a mask-image or background for the Matchmaking active queue state.

default_avatar.usage: Default profile image for users who haven't uploaded an avatar.

technical_instructions_for_main_agent: Install fonts via Google Fonts in index.html: Rajdhani (weights 400,600,700) and Exo 2 (weights 300,400,600).
Configure Tailwind with custom colors under theme.extend.colors (primary, secondary, danger, etc).
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor icons for UI elements (swords for match, shield for teams, user for profile).
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='matchmaking-start-btn').
The matchmaking active state must obscure the dashboard slightly (backdrop blur) to focus attention on the queue.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, tabs, and modals, but strip the generic white/gray borders and apply the custom dark theme with neon borders.
Ensure the hero background image has a gradient overlay so text remains readable (e.g., 'bg-gradient-to-b from-black/80 via-black/60 to-[#05030A]').
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>, use Shadcn equivalents.
Do NOT use TSX files if the environment uses JS. Share JS guidelines.
Use framer-motion for the matchmaking button pulse and screen transitions.
